about: Scored rows that need an independent audio or human check before they count in any verified total. Record each check in data/accuracy/verifications.json (append-only: uid, method audio|human, reviewer, verdict confirmed|rejected|changed, evidence {t_start, t_end, quote}, confidence, at).
